issues.description: Stock.findStockIngredient has inconsistent signatures: the problem statement/UML requires findStockIngredient(String), but the template provides findStockIngredient(String, boolean caseSensitive). Students following the template API will not match the required UML/tests/reference solution API.
issues.suggestedFix: Align the template with the required API by adding/changing to `public StockIngredient findStockIngredient(String name)` (single parameter). If case-insensitive lookup is desired, document it explicitly and implement it consistently (e.g., always ignore case) without changing the required signature.

issues.description: SealSaloon.stock visibility is inconsistent: the UML association indicates protected visibility (# stock), but the reference solution declares `private static final Stock stock`. This may confuse students about the required access modifier for the field.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the specification consistent: either update the UML to show private (`- stock`) to match intended encapsulation/reference solution, or change the reference solution (and expected student implementation/tests) to use protected visibility.

issues.description: SealSaloon methods/fields are specified as static in the text but shown as instance members in the UML: the problem statement explicitly requires `stock`, `acceptSupplyDelivery(...)`, and `calculateTotalPrice(Meal)` to be static, while the UML lists these methods as normal instance methods (no static notation). This can mislead students who implement directly from the diagram.
issues.suggestedFix: Update the UML to clearly mark static members (e.g., underline or add `{static}`) for `stock`, `acceptSupplyDelivery`, and `calculateTotalPrice` so it matches the written instructions and reference solution.
